name: single-stream
description: One conversation at a time: a closed loop at concurrency 1 over the default prompts (each request a different prompt, thinking off), 60 s warm-up and 300 s measured. The speed one user sees, which draft acceptance on the generated text moves; the release suites' engine grid stays the text-independent verdict on a single stream's step cost. Every release runs it beside its release suite, so the release suites and their recorded references stay unchanged.
